comments.author: @SolarpunkAcademy
comments.text: Interesting to see how little Sam knows about de-growth and how he strawmans the whole thing. I know it’s in the nature of the situation that he’s a techno optimist, but to what degree was hitherto not known for me. UBI fits into post-growth economics btw, and de-growth is a necessary stage on the way to post-growth. Prof. Herman Daly has outlined the steady-state model already a long time ago, and yes, we can and will have to use regenerative, circular practices which will be enhanced and optimalized by AI, alongside new scientific discoveries - but we still live on a finite planet, with finite resources with an ever increasing population where the wealth and resources are horded in the global north, there has to be a fair transition where extreme peaks and extreme lows gets more equalized, and grows the middle, there is no way around that, and the real danger is fantasies of eternal, explosive growth due to an all-powerful AI tool that will unlock the secrets of the Universe and hord even more resources and power to just one small part of the world or the pyramid.
